sql.query: INSERT INTO tbl_tenant_email_settings (tenantId,replyToAddress,archiveBccAddress,copyInitiatingUser,copyWorkflowOwner,emailFooterHtml,createdByUserId,modifiedByUserId) SELECT :tenantId,NULLIF(LOWER(TRIM(:replyTo)),''),NULLIF(LOWER(TRIM(:archiveBcc)),''),:copyUser,:copyOwner,NULLIF(:footer,''),:userId,:modifiedUserId FROM DUAL WHERE (:replyTo2='' OR :replyTo3 REGEXP '^[^@[:space:]]+@[^@[:space:]]+[.][^@[:space:]]+$') AND (:archiveBcc2='' OR :archiveBcc3 REGEXP '^[^@[:space:]]+@[^@[:space:]]+[.][^@[:space:]]+$') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenant_roles utr INNER JOIN tbl_role_permissions rp ON rp.roleId=utr.roleId INNER JOIN tbl_permissions p ON p.id=rp.permissionId AND p.permissionCode='email.configure' AND p.isActive=1 WHERE utr.userId=:permissionUser AND utr.tenantId=:permissionTenant AND utr.isActive=1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE replyToAddress=VALUES(replyToAddress),archiveBccAddress=VALUES(archiveBccAddress),copyInitiatingUser=VALUES(copyInitiatingUser),copyWorkflowOwner=VALUES(copyWorkflowOwner),emailFooterHtml=VALUES(emailFooterHtml),rowVersion=rowVersion+1,modifiedByUserId=VALUES(modifiedByUserId),modifiedDate=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
